study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Coupé et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2022
study_identification_part.si4_title: Hippocampal-amygdalo-ventricular atrophy score: Alzheimer disease detection using normative and pathological lifespan models

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states the objective to present a new MRI-based method (HAVAs) for AD detection and MCI prognosis using lifespan trajectories.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: In this article, we present an innovative MRI-based method for Alzheimer disease (AD) detection and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prognostic, using lifespan trajectories of brain structures.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: The study describes the composition of the reference cohort (2,655 CN subjects from 7 open databases) and quality control procedures (RegQCNet + visual). Specific inclusion/exclusion criteria for each original dataset are not detailed but the original databases are cited.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases... This dataset was composed of 2,655 CN subjects... For all the training subjects detected as failure by the automatic QC RegQCNet... a visual assessment was performed

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age is the primary covariate in the lifespan models. ICV is used for volume normalization. Sex is not explicitly mentioned as a covariate in the polynomial models, though the gender distribution is reported.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: we normalized all the structure volumes using the intracranial cavity volume (ICV)... estimated normal and pathological trajectories... as a function of age... normalized volumes are expressed as z-scores

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The databases used for the reference cohort are clearly listed: C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, and ADNI.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases (Table 1)... C-MIND... NDAR... ABIDE... ICBM... IXI... OASIS... ADNI

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: The study uses secondary data from existing open access databases.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: The preprocessing pipeline (AssemblyNet) is described in detail, including denoising, inhomogeneity correction, registration, and quality control.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: All the considered images were processed using AssemblyNet software... image denoising... inhomogeneity correction... affine registration... automatic quality control... intensity standardization

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The study uses a separate 'Testing dataset' for validation (external). It does not explicitly describe an internal data partitioning strategy (like K-fold CV) on the 'Training dataset' during the model building phase, other than selecting models based on BIC.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases... we used the Bayesian Information Criterion

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The normative model is applied to independent external datasets (AIBL and MIRIAD) which were not used for model development.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases (AIBL and MIRIAD) to perform AD versus CN diagnosis task.

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical approach (polynomial regression) and model selection (BIC) are described.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: we considered several low order polynomial models: Linear... Quadratic... Cubic... used the Bayesian Information Criterion

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: Quantitative metrics (R2, F-statistic) are reported for the models.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Table 4 Results of model analysis... R2... F-statistic

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: Characteristics (N, Gender, Age) are provided for the Training dataset (used for building models) and Testing dataset (used for validation).
nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.supporting_text: Table 1 Training dataset description... Table 2 External dataset used for validation

nm11_reproducibility.reason: The software used (AssemblyNet) is available on GitHub, and the authors state the new method (HAVAs) will be made available.
nm11_reproducibility.supporting_text: AssemblyNet is freely available at https://github.com/volBrain/AssemblyNet. HAVAs will be made available... as a downloadable Docker

cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.reason: The study uses existing clinical cohorts (ADNI, AIBL, MIRIAD) and refers to ClinicaDL software for group definitions. Specific diagnostic criteria are not detailed in the text.
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: used the ClinicaDL software... to define the groups of AD and CN groups in AIBL, and the pMCI and sMCI groups in ADNI. Therefore, we used the same selection criteria.

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: The analysis focuses on group differences (AD vs CN, sMCI vs pMCI) using the deviation scores. Clinical covariates beyond basic demographics (like medication, symptom severity) are not used in the analysis of the deviation scores.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: Covariates such as age and sex are considered [implied via demographics tables, but not in deviation analysis]
